title: Quicksort
definition: Quicksort partitions the array around a pivot and sorts the left and right parts recursively.
realLifeExample: It is like choosing one card as a pivot and splitting smaller and larger cards around it.

algorithm.Iterative:
1. Choose a pivot.
2. Partition the array so smaller values come before the pivot.
3. Repeat for left and right sections using a stack.
4. Continue until all sections are sorted.
algorithm.Functions:
1. Partition the array around a pivot.
2. Recursively sort the left part.
3. Recursively sort the right part.
4. Return the sorted array.
algorithm.Recursion:
1. If the range has one or zero elements, stop.
2. Partition around the pivot.
3. Recurse on left and right ranges.
